missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend a calcium supplement until total dietary calcium, age/life stage, current products and kidney-stone history are reviewed.
safety_exclusions: Low dairy intake does not necessarily mean low calcium intake; include non-dairy sources and fortified foods.
Do not recommend supplementation without estimating total intake from food and products.
Do not advise indiscriminate calcium restriction or excess.
professional_escalation_conditions: History of kidney stones, hypercalcemia, kidney disease, parathyroid disorders or malabsorption.
Pregnancy, osteoporosis treatment or abnormal calcium-related laboratory results.
population_and_context: People reporting low dairy and fortified-food intake; assess all dietary calcium sources and life-stage requirements before estimating a dietary gap.
dose_constraints: Only consider a supplement to bridge a verified dietary gap; calculate elemental calcium and total daily intake against age-specific references and UL. No dose from this rule.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Calcium fact sheet provides food sources, reference intakes and upper limits. The questionnaire must estimate total intake rather than use dairy consumption as a proxy.
